please follow this https://github.com/openbmc/docs/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#formatting-commit-messages

On how the commit message looks.
please address CI failures.. check OpenBMC CI build - 100730

u can skip mentioning of :param. We usually follow this format. For reference u can check any python file in openbmc-test-automation.



Description of arguments:
sensor_threshold_values  Dictionary of threshold values.
sensor_id                Sensor identifier (e.g. "fan_1").
Remove the additional spaces throughout
Commonly we prefer two lines space before the starting new function.
provide the sample output for reference.
Thanks for your reply ,i have made the changes as you told, can you pls take a look at it and let me know if any modification needed? The new changes made has been pushed...

Commonly followed commit format

<commit message>

changes:
<Add the change info here>

Tested:
<Provide info about the test for the change>
Pls add a new line after this line throughout.
Pls keep this in the previous line
Cite an example pls to better understand this code
